trans-unit.source: Open a video or Live Photo and choose 'Shrink video' or 'Keep as regular photo' under More. The original goes to Set aside first.
trans-unit.target: Open a video or Live Photo and choose 'Shrink video' or 'Keep as regular photo' under More. The original goes to Set aside first.

trans-unit.id: Opslaan is niet gelukt. Er is niets veranderd.

Per groep blijft één contact over met alle nummers en adressen. De andere worden verwijderd. Dit kan Fotoswipe niet terugdraaien. Gebruik je iCloud, dan kun je contacten op iCloud.com tot 30 dagen terugzetten.
trans-unit.source: Each group becomes one contact with all numbers and addresses. The others are deleted. Fotoswipe can't undo this. If you use iCloud, you can restore contacts on iCloud.com for up to 30 days.
trans-unit.target: Each group becomes one contact with all numbers and addresses. The others are deleted. Fotoswipe can't undo this. If you use iCloud, you can restore contacts on iCloud.com for up to 30 days.

trans-unit.id: Rechts is bewaren, links is wegleggen. Twijfel? Tik op het klokje voor later.
trans-unit.source: Right is keep, left is set aside. Not sure? Tap the clock for later.
trans-unit.target: Right is keep, left is set aside. Not sure? Tap the clock for later.

trans-unit.id: Reeks: %lld dagen. Eén dag overslaan mag.|==|plural.one
trans-unit.source: Streak: %lld day. Skipping one day is fine.
trans-unit.target: Streak: %lld day. Skipping one day is fine.

trans-unit.id: Reeks: %lld dagen. Eén dag overslaan mag.|==|plural.other
trans-unit.source: Streak: %lld days. Skipping one day is fine.
trans-unit.target: Streak: %lld days. Skipping one day is fine.

trans-unit.id: Ruim één reis tegelijk op en voeg dubbele contacten samen, in Slim opruimen.
trans-unit.source: Clean up one trip at a time and merge duplicate contacts, in Smart Clean.
trans-unit.target: Clean up one trip at a time and merge duplicate contacts, in Smart Clean.

trans-unit.id: Ruimte komt pas vrij na 'Recent verwijderd'
trans-unit.source: Space is only freed after 'Recently Deleted'
trans-unit.target: Space is only freed after 'Recently Deleted'

trans-unit.id: Scan gestopt. Start opnieuw om groepen te zoeken.
trans-unit.source: Scan stopped. Start again to find groups.
trans-unit.target: Scan stopped. Start again to find groups.

trans-unit.id: Selectie weggelegd. Controleer alle items in Bekijken.
trans-unit.source: Selection set aside. Review all items in Review.
trans-unit.target: Selection set aside. Review all items in Review.

trans-unit.id: Slim opruimen zet burstfoto's, kopieën en rommel klaar, met de grootste winst bovenaan.
trans-unit.source: Smart Clean lines up burst photos, copies and clutter, with the biggest savings at the top.
trans-unit.target: Smart Clean lines up burst photos, copies and clutter, with the biggest savings at the top.

trans-unit.id: Tik op 'Weggelegd' onderaan. Tik op een foto om hem toch te bewaren.
trans-unit.source: Tap 'Set aside' at the bottom. Tap a photo to keep it after all.
trans-unit.target: Tap 'Set aside' at the bottom. Tap a photo to keep it after all.

trans-unit.id: Tik op Focus: de foto vult het scherm en je swipet met gebaren.
trans-unit.source: Tap Focus: the photo fills the screen and you swipe with gestures.
trans-unit.target: Tap Focus: the photo fills the screen and you swipe with gestures.

trans-unit.id: Tik op Verwijder en bevestig in het venster van iOS.
trans-unit.source: Tap Delete and confirm in the iOS dialog.
trans-unit.target: Tap Delete and confirm in the iOS dialog.

trans-unit.id: Tik op een foto om details te bekijken. Kies daarna welke je wilt wegleggen.
trans-unit.source: Tap a photo to see details. Then choose which ones to set aside.
trans-unit.target: Tap a photo to see details. Then choose which ones to set aside.

trans-unit.id: Tik op een item om het te bekijken. Met Terug zet je het terug in de stapel.
trans-unit.source: Tap an item to view it. Tap Back to put it back in the stack.
trans-unit.target: Tap an item to view it. Tap Back to put it back in the stack.

trans-unit.id: Tip: kies volledige toegang om je hele bibliotheek op te ruimen. Een selectie kan ook.
trans-unit.source: Tip: choose full access to clean up your whole library. A selection works too.
trans-unit.target: Tip: choose full access to clean up your whole library. A selection works too.

trans-unit.id: Toevoegen is niet gelukt. Je keuzes zijn bewaard.
trans-unit.source: Couldn't add. Your choices have been saved.
trans-unit.target: Couldn't add. Your choices have been saved.

trans-unit.id: Veeg de kaart naar rechts om te bewaren
trans-unit.source: Swipe the card right to keep
trans-unit.target: Swipe the card right to keep

trans-unit.id: Veeg naar rechts om te bewaren, naar links om weg te leggen, omhoog voor later.
trans-unit.source: Swipe right to keep, left to set aside, up for later.
trans-unit.target: Swipe right to keep, left to set aside, up for later.

trans-unit.id: Vergelijkbare foto's zijn kandidaten, geen bewezen duplicaten. Vergelijk zelf en bewaar minstens één foto per groep.
trans-unit.source: Similar photos are candidates, not proven duplicates. Compare them yourself and keep at least one photo per group.
trans-unit.target: Similar photos are candidates, not proven duplicates. Compare them yourself and keep at least one photo per group.

trans-unit.id: Verkleinen is niet gelukt. Er is niets veranderd.
Verkleinen is voor deze video niet mogelijk.
Verwijderde foto's blijven 30 dagen in Foto's > Albums > Recent verwijderd. Wil je de ruimte meteen? Kies daar Verwijder alles. Een app mag dat album niet zelf legen.
trans-unit.source: Deleted photos stay in Photos > Albums > Recently Deleted for 30 days. Want the space right away? Choose Delete All there. Apps aren't allowed to empty that album themselves.
trans-unit.target: Deleted photos stay in Photos > Albums > Recently Deleted for 30 days. Want the space right away? Choose Delete All there. Apps aren't allowed to empty that album themselves.

trans-unit.id: Verwijderen geldt ook voor je andere apparaten met dezelfde iCloud-fotobibliotheek. Foto's die alleen in iCloud staan, worden even opgehaald om ze te tonen.
trans-unit.source: Deleting also applies to your other devices with the same iCloud Photos library. Photos that are only in iCloud are briefly downloaded to show them.
trans-unit.target: Deleting also applies to your other devices with the same iCloud Photos library. Photos that are only in iCloud are briefly downloaded to show them.

trans-unit.id: Waarom komt de ruimte niet direct vrij?
trans-unit.source: Why isn't the space freed up right away?
trans-unit.target: Why isn't the space freed up right away?

trans-unit.id: Wazige foto's, bonnetjes, notities en screenshots komen vooraan. Jij beslist.
trans-unit.source: Blurry photos, receipts, notes and screenshots come first. You decide.
trans-unit.target: Blurry photos, receipts, notes and screenshots come first. You decide.

trans-unit.source: Set-aside items go to Review first
trans-unit.target: Set-aside items go to Review first

trans-unit.id: Ze komen terug in de stapels. Weggelegde items blijven weggelegd.
trans-unit.source: They go back into the stacks. Set-aside items stay set aside.
trans-unit.target: They go back into the stacks. Set-aside items stay set aside.

trans-unit.id: Ze staan als knoppen onder de foto. Eén tik zet de foto in dat album en gaat door naar de volgende.
trans-unit.source: They appear as buttons under the photo. One tap files the photo in that album and moves on to the next.
trans-unit.target: They appear as buttons under the photo. One tap files the photo in that album and moves on to the next.

trans-unit.id: Ze staan nog 30 dagen in 'Recent verwijderd' in Foto's; pas daarna komt de ruimte vrij. Wil je de ruimte nu al? Open Foto's, ga naar Albums > Recent verwijderd en kies Verwijder alles.
trans-unit.source: They stay in 'Recently Deleted' in Photos for 30 days; only then is the space freed up. Want the space now? Open Photos, go to Albums > Recently Deleted and choose Delete All.
trans-unit.target: They stay in 'Recently Deleted' in Photos for 30 days; only then is the space freed up. Want the space now? Open Photos, go to Albums > Recently Deleted and choose Delete All.

trans-unit.id: Zet tot 3 albums onder de foto. Eén tik en hij staat erin.
trans-unit.source: Pin up to 3 albums under the photo. One tap and it's in.
trans-unit.target: Pin up to 3 albums under the photo. One tap and it's in.

trans-unit.source: Search for a category or album
trans-unit.target: Search for a category or album
